يرتضون (form VIII)
# يَرْتَضُونَ (yartaḍūna) /jar.ta.dˤuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَضَى (irtaḍā)
# يُرْتَضَوْنَ (yurtaḍawna) /jur.ta.dˤaw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَضَى (irtaḍā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
